assertion: The product hierarchy was remapped for a new category structure. The mapping between the legacy and new hierarchy has been maintained manually ever since, rather than being migrated into the merchandising master.

constrains.effect: Manual mapping drifts from the master, so valuation failures recur
The manual step was never written down
Legacy 'department' and new 'category' are both in use and not interchangeable

assertion: No team owns the legacy-to-new hierarchy mapping table. Merchandising believes the data platform owns it because it is consumed there; the data platform believes Merchandising owns it because it is master data.

constrains.effect: No required reviewer, because no owner is registered
Ownership questions are answered defensively in writing
Fixes address the symptom because no owner drives the control

assertion: Month-end close is expected to complete within four business days of period end. Overruns are escalated to the Group CFO the same day.

constrains.effect: Close cycle time is a standing CFO metric
Status reporting increases sharply during close
Manual workarounds are tolerated to protect the close date

assertion: The checkout and loyalty stack was replatformed. Conversion has been volatile since, and forecasting for the online unit has not been re-baselined against post-replatform behaviour.

constrains.effect: Conversion is watched weekly by the Digital MD
Digital forecasts miss more often than other units
Change freezes are applied around peak trading

assertion: General Merchandise defends margin performance by pointing to promotional depth agreed with Food for joint campaigns. Food regards those campaigns as General Merchandise's commercial choice.

constrains.effect: Margin commentary attributes cause outside the unit
Promotional depth is reported separately by unit
Joint campaign governance generates extra papers
